paper.title: Deep learning to represent sub-grid processes in climate models

verdict: REPLICATED (methodology + central diagnostic conservation claim) / PARTIAL (offline R² magnitude, data-limited)

data.caveat: paper trained on ~140M samples; we have 0.5% of that, hence F5

headline_metric_paper: implied ~0.7 mean R²(ΔT) from companion Gentine 2018 GRL on full corpus
headline_metric_ours: 0.247 mean R²(ΔT), 0.654 max R²(ΔT) -- 3x below paper mean, on par at column peak
qualitative_claims_replicated_pass1: 9x256 LeakyReLU MSE Adam trains stably on SPCAM tendencies
ΔQ skillful in convection band, TOA degenerate (5 levs auto-masked)
repass_diagnostic_claims_replicated: C1/C2 — layer-by-layer param count 557,372 (98.24% of paper's 567,361)
C5  — 18-epoch sufficiency: val-loss minimum at ep17-18 (val=0.4632), worse at ep19-20
C10 — NN heating-field zonal climatology, tropical correlation r=0.991
C11 — NN moistening-field zonal climatology, tropical correlation r=0.991
C12 — NN ITCZ at 6.98°N vs paper's stated ~5°N (closer to paper than short-sample SPCAM truth)
C16 — column moist static energy near-conservation: NN slope 0.978 vs SPCAM truth 0.986 (paper Fig 4A)
C21 — NN inference 8.4 µs/column CPU, ~0.07 s/global-step << SPCAM 0.5-2 s/step (speed claim plausible)
repass_diagnostic_claims_inconclusive: C13 — ITCZ FWHM both NN and truth = 11.16° in this 48-snapshot sample (paper's 'slightly sharper' claim not resolvable)

out_of_scope_blocked.C17_energy_stable_5yr: Requires modified SPCAM Fortran (gitlab.com/mspritch/spcam3.0-neural-net) + CAM build environment
out_of_scope_blocked.C23_wavenumber1_SST_perturbation: Perturbed-SST SPCAM dataset not on Zenodo + prognostic CAM
out_of_scope_blocked.C24_plus4K_extrapolation: +4K SST SPCAM dataset NOT on Zenodo (private to UC Irvine) + prognostic CAM
out_of_scope_blocked.C25_climate_interpolation: Same as C24 + two-climate-trained NN checkpoint
